Title: Think ear infections are just a kids' thing? Think again

Description:
Adults get ear infections too, and it usually comes down to one blocked tube. Untreated colds, flying without equalizing pressure, and regular smoke exposure can all keep your Eustachian tube shut and let fluid build up behind your eardrum. Here's why each one happens, and simple fixes for all three.
